items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, Sarah got him to work with the group... Bruz Freeman... But this formed Sarah Vaughan's first trio... we had maybe... up until Christmas week of 1953... that we worked together

ctx.x: Oscar Pettiford and all of them. But Israel Crosby was the kind of guy that, if you didn't know it, you'd never hear from him that he was even a musician,

Anyway, Sarah got him to work with the group, and a drummer who really came from a musical family. I never did know what his first was -- we used to call him "Bruz" and his last name was Freeman. Bruz Freeman. Bruz had a brother that played guitar [GEORGE FREEMAN] and his other brother plays tenor saxophone [VON FREEMAN], and I think now one of his sons is quite a tenor player...
